product.title: New York City Sunset or Daytime Sightseeing Cruise
product.description: Set sail on a 1950s-style yacht for an unforgettable 90-minute sightseeing cruise around New York Harbor. Enjoy stunning sunset views of Manhattan’s skyline, the Statue of Liberty, and other iconic landmarks. Relax on the open bow or covered outdoor deck while sipping a complimentary beverage and nibbling on light hors d'oeuvres. Capture breathtaking photos of New York's most famous landmarks and enjoy this scenic adventure with friends and family.
highlights: Cruise along the Hudson River for sweeping views of Manhattan's skyline
Get up-close views of the Statue of Liberty from the water
Enjoy a relaxing ambiance on a vintage 1950s-style yacht
One complimentary beverage and light hors d'oeuvres included
exclusions: Additional beverages available for purchase by credit card

Please check in at the Classic Harbor Line ticket booth upon arrival.
